$comment: Mechanically-enforced gate baselines (see EVALS.md rules). run-routing.mjs prints a gate verdict on every run and exits 1 on breach when invoked with --gate (CI does). Re-baselining is an explicit act: update these numbers, evidence input fingerprints, and accepted totals in the same commit as the change that moves them, with the decision recorded in the round ledger. Counts are absolute hits, not percentages. A raw local trace name is optional evidence.localTrace context, never the committed evidence identity.
